description: This file implements the FeatureExpressionImpl class, which represents a feature-focused expression in a query language, providing methods for visitor acceptance, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: FeatureExpressionImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a feature-based expression with visitor pattern support, equality, and string representation.

methods.name: FeatureExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the featureId field, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for existence-related expressions and delegates to visitFeature method.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general field expression visitor and delegates to visitFeature method.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID associated with this expression.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare featureId fields for equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce hash based on featureId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the feature expression, including the featureId.
